issue.title: Published agents-sidecar run state freezes mid-run: 8,659 of 15,457 records still say active/waiting days after the runs ended
issue.description:
Published agent run state in the agents sidecar freezes at whatever state the run had when its hood was last published, which is usually mid-run.

Measured 2026-09-28 on apollo against `~/.sase/projects/gh_sase-org__sase/repos/agents` (clone HEAD 2026-09-28):

- 15,457 `agents/*/state.json` records (athena 14,306, apollo 836, kellys_mbp 315).
- States: active 7,631, completed 4,600, failed 1,391, waiting 1,109, dismissed 726.
- 8,659 records say `active`/`waiting` although `started_at` is more than 2 days old. Example: `agents/bbugyi200.athena.zz--plan/state.json` has said `active`, `finished_at: null`, since 2026-08-13.
- Stale share by start month: 2026-05 0%, 2026-06 0%, 2026-07 54%, 2026-08 70%, 2026-09 62%. It is structural and started in July. It predates the September manifest outage (sase-10x / sase-11o) and persists after athena's manifest resumed updating on 2026-09-25.

Likely cause (docs/agents_sidecar.md "Scope and reconciliation", lines ~178-199 and ~310-335):

- Targeted publication runs at commit time and snapshots the committing agent's whole top-level hood, including siblings that are still running. The committer itself is also still active.
- Terminal state is refreshed only by a later commit in the same hood or by an explicit `sase agent sync` or the Updates-pane `a` action.
- Nothing schedules that full reconciliation, and nothing republishes a hood when its runs finish.

Fix options, not yet decided:

1. Republish the hood, or enqueue a publication-outbox request, when a run in a hood with at least one commit reaches a terminal state, e.g. from the finalizer or the done marker.
2. A routine job that runs full reconciliation at a low cadence.
3. Either one plus a one-time backfill across owners.

Readers should also treat a non-terminal published state older than its publish time as "as of publish", never as live.

task_type_fields.impact: Published agent and hood pages, @agent: resolution metadata, and any future Agents-tab or CLI reader of published history show runs from July to September as still running. This blocks showing published history in the TUI without an 'as of publish' caveat.
task_type_fields.location: src/sase/agents_sync/ (targeted hood publication + sase agent sync reconciliation); ~/.sase/projects/<key>/repos/agents/agents/*/state.json
task_type_fields.repro: In the local agents clone, count agents/*/state.json whose state is active or waiting and whose started_at is more than 2 days old. On apollo, sase project, 2026-09-28: 8,659 of 15,457. Spot check: agents/bbugyi200.athena.zz--plan/state.json.

issue.creation_reason: Found while researching whether the Agents tab could browse published agent history; the published pages (and any future reader) present thousands of long-finished runs as running.
